name: How long does garage floor coating installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does garage floor coating installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of garage floor coating installation typically depends on the chosen material and the size and condition of your garage. Epoxy systems can take 2-3 days for application, with additional cure time before full use. Polyaspartic coatings are often a quicker process, sometimes completed in a single day, with a faster return-to-service time. Surface preparation, including cleaning and repairs, is a significant factor in the overall timeline. Your contractor will provide a clear schedule based on your specific project details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 1-3 days, depending on the material and garage size. Polyaspartic coatings are faster than epoxy, but preparation time is always a factor.
